english.notes:
(i) The CMA can require an undertaking involved in, or connected with, the distribution, supply or retail of motor fuel to give specified information to the CMA, for details see section 311 of the Digital Markets, Competition and Consumers Act 2024.
(ii) In case of failure a penalty may be imposed by the CMA under section 312, but a penalty under that section may not be imposed where a person has been found guilty of an offence under section 315 in relation to the act/omission; and a person may not be found guilty of this offence if he or she has paid the penalty imposed under section 312, see section 316.
(iii) For corporate liability see section 315(5)-(8).
